optimization_config.rationale: Designed because the extracted spec lacked optimization_config. hmin/hmax chosen as 1% and 10% of the unit-square domain; diffusion=1e-4 standard for level-set regularization; v0=1e-3 small initial velocity; 30 iterations typical; initial level set taken from extracted \phi_0; design boundary labels from extracted design_role: only Robin \Gamma_c (label 3) is movable; fixed labels are the fixed Dirichlet and Neumann boundaries (labels 1,2,4); label 10 (solid-void boundary) not listed.
